addon.notes:
# New

### General
* Combined the addon/app in the auto-updater so that they always install together moving forward to make the update experience more intuitive.

### Gear Pull
* Added preliminary support for pulling equipment based on the character's GearSwap job lua files as a toggle.

### Tagging
* Added the ability to designate exact pieces of equipment (i.e. equipment with specific augments) inside tags.

### Auction House
* Greatly increased speed of listing items on the AH from Alexandria. Also added an option configure the listing delay in Settings > Behavior.
* Added a new "All Characters" view under Listings which shows all listings across all characters as well as the total value of all listed items.

### Storage Slips
* New Storage Slips view showing each slip's contents with proper gear icons.

### Unity
* Now pulls the equipment to be augmented from its original bag and then returns it after augmenting is complete.

### Reforge
* Added a toggle that allows seeing items that are currently stored in Storage Slips as well as enables pulling those items if near a Porter Moogle.

### Treasure Pool
* Added a new toggle to automatically pass Rare items you already own. Off by default.
* When setting Opacity to 0%, the Treasure Pool is hidden and only shown when hovering over it.

### Consolidate
* Added Select All / None buttons to Consolidate.

### Drop List
* Now shows a potential item list based on the input while typing.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed an issue where BLM artifact gloves (Spaekona) was incorrectly displaying and searching for the wrong stage (+4).
